hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook-based token launchpad (pmav.fun V2) that deploys ERC-20 coins with a concentrated bonding curve position, enforces fair-launch rules including a block+1 trading delay, a 2% first-hour buy cap with auto-refund, and a decaying anti-snipe premium. Charges a 1% fee split 70/30 creator/platform. Graduates coins by replacing the curve with a permanently locked full-range position in the same pool.
